b376ad01-17c0-4b86-88f9-65bda8a59dd6/Eve.en: Months have passed since <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s clash with the Mysterious One.<NL>One day, as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> organizes their Travel Bag at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>, they suddenly sense a faint tremor within the pouch in their bosom...
b376ad01-17c0-4b86-88f9-65bda8a59dd6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>自那日与神秘人交手，转眼已过数月，<NL>这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>收整行囊，忽觉怀中锦囊似有异动……
b376ad01-17c0-4b86-88f9-65bda8a59dd6/Eve.ru: С тех пор прошли месяцы <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>это столкновение с Таинственным Существом.<NL>Однажды, как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> организует их дорожную сумку в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>, они внезапно ощущают слабую дрожь в мешочке у себя на груди...

7dde840f-2a97-4b57-90cd-549b078a946d/Eve.en: With a stir in their heart, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> draws forth the pouch—<NL>only to find the golden thread within crumbling into ash in an instant, scattering into the air...<NL><NL>Now that the golden thread has perished, all traces of the Mysterious One's origins have vanished forever...
7dde840f-2a97-4b57-90cd-549b078a946d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头一动，当即探手取出锦囊——<NL>却见其中金丝，眨眼之间，竟而化烬成灰，四散而去……<NL><NL>金丝既灭，那神秘人来历，终是再无迹可寻……

104d19a9-2510-4e02-b021-c7b2a5c7c24a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hides in the shadows, watching from afar, <NL>seeing figures moving at the cave entrance, heavily guarded; a rash approach would stir up the snakes...<NL><NL>Hesitating, he suddenly remembers the <color=#orange>Heavenly Veil Cloak</color> obtained from that Mysterious One earlier, and a plan comes to mind...
104d19a9-2510-4e02-b021-c7b2a5c7c24a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>隐在暗处，远远观望，<NL>但见洞口人影绰绰，戒备森严，自己若是贸然靠近，不免打草惊蛇……<NL><NL>正自踌躇，忽而想起此前于那神秘人身上所得的<color=#orange>天幕隐衣</color>，一时计上心头……

104d19a9-2510-4e02-b021-c7b2a5c7c24a/Opt.en: (Perhaps change into the clothes left by that Mysterious One, disguise a little...)
104d19a9-2510-4e02-b021-c7b2a5c7c24a/Opt.cn: （不妨换上那神秘人所遗衣衫，稍作乔装……）
104d19a9-2510-4e02-b021-c7b2a5c7c24a/Opt.ru: (Возможно, переодеться в одежду, оставленную тем Таинственным Человеком, немного замаскироваться...)

60ad607f-b53e-474e-a4b3-ace5d1d0b8d7/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> approaches the entrance, a guard intercepts them.<NL>The man crosses his wrists with palms upturned toward the heavens, his head bowed as he intones:<NL>"Heaven's majesty shines bright, the Skyveil hangs mysterious. This mere insect's form, I offer before the Lord.<NL>Life is but grass, death but dust. Between the vault and the earth, naught remains but the mandate of Heaven."<NL><NL>Recalling the movements of those who entered before,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> maintains a stoic facade and mimics the salute, then draws the golden thread from the pouch to present it to the guard...
60ad607f-b53e-474e-a4b3-ace5d1d0b8d7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行至洞口，一名守卫便即上前，<NL>只见那人双手交叠于腕，掌心向天，高高托起，低眉垂首，口中诵道：<NL>“天威昭昭，天幕垂玄，蝼蚁微躯，奉吾尊前，<NL>生如草芥，死作尘烟，俯仰坤乾，惟天命然。”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思及此前几名入洞的神秘人，<NL>当下不动声色，依样行礼，随后自锦囊取出金丝，奉予守卫……

60ad607f-b53e-474e-a4b3-ace5d1d0b8d7/Opt.en: ("Heaven's majesty shines bright, the Skyveil hangs mysterious..." Whatever could this mean?)
60ad607f-b53e-474e-a4b3-ace5d1d0b8d7/Opt.cn: （天威昭昭，天幕垂玄……不知何意……）
60ad607f-b53e-474e-a4b3-ace5d1d0b8d7/Opt.ru: ("Небесное величие сияет ярко, Небесный свод таинственно нависает..." Что бы это могло означать?)

da2163bc-402d-4bb3-ae20-2166d7692588/Eve.en: Finding no fault, the guard returns the golden thread with both hands.<NL>Yet as he raises his gaze to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, a flicker of doubt crosses his eyes.<NL>Before he can begin his interrogation, a sharp voice calls out from behind:<NL><NL>"The Leader has orders to deliver, so waste no time! Do you truly fear that some lowly insect could have crept inside?"
da2163bc-402d-4bb3-ae20-2166d7692588/Eve.cn: 守卫查验无误，双手奉回金丝，<NL>抬眼看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>时，眸中掠过一丝疑色，<NL>正待开口盘问，身后却传来阵阵催促：<NL><NL>“首领有事交代，莫要磨蹭——怎么，还怕有蝼蚁能混进去不成？”

4c597cf1-ebd5-4750-a76c-bec6222b4701/Eve.en: "The Leader has orders to share. Be quick and get inside..."
4c597cf1-ebd5-4750-a76c-bec6222b4701/Eve.cn: “首领有事交代，还不快些进去……”
4c597cf1-ebd5-4750-a76c-bec6222b4701/Eve.ru: "У Лидера есть приказ поделиться. Поторопись и зайди внутрь..."

c37165df-c915-4ceb-9de9-54893648021c/Eve.en: The tunnel is dark and narrow, such that one cannot see their own hand before them.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> advances with caution until, at last, the space widens into a great chamber.<NL>A dozen mysterious figures line the path in silence, heads bowed like statues of wood and clay.<NL>High upon a distant stone dais, a figure stands with hands clasped behind their back, garbed in flying-silk raiment and a belt of jeweled nectar-stamen, possessing an air far beyond that of any common mortal...<NL><NL>This, it seems, is the Leader of this mysterious band...
c37165df-c915-4ceb-9de9-54893648021c/Eve.cn: 甬道幽深逼仄，伸手不见五指，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>谨慎前行，不知过了多久，眼前豁然开朗——<NL>十数名神秘人分列左右，人人肃立，垂手低眉，好似木雕泥塑，<NL>远处高处石台之上，一人负手而立，身着飞锦衣裳，琼蕊宝带，观之绝非凡俗中人……<NL><NL>想来，此人便是这群神秘人的首领……

ccc5b645-daa9-47d4-a879-6eefb6ccb8c9/Eve.en: "Fellow Daoists, you have traveled far through wind and dust. Your labors are great..."<NL>The Leader lifts a flowing sleeve, his voice echoing as if descending from the highest heavens:<NL><NL>"And yet... mortals are but creatures of mud and mire, scions of demonic blood.<NL>Their treacherous hearts have never been quelled since antiquity. Now they seek to gather their rebel brood through this Martial World Tournament to defile the Skyveil.<NL>As we serve the Lord Under the Dome, charged to monitor these mortals and uphold the Heavenly Way, how could we dare the slightest negligence?"
ccc5b645-daa9-47d4-a879-6eefb6ccb8c9/Eve.cn: “诸位道友远道而来，一路风尘，好生辛劳……”<NL>神秘人首领轻扬广袖，音声渺渺，如自九天垂落：<NL><NL>“然而……凡人污泥所造，妖魔遗血，<NL>自古反心不泯，今更欲借武林盟会纠集叛众，祸乱天帷，<NL>吾等奉天幕主之令，监管凡人，护持天道，岂敢稍有懈怠……”

ccc5b645-daa9-47d4-a879-6eefb6ccb8c9/Opt.en: (The Lord Under the Dome... overseeing mortals...)

c0c7e9cc-beff-4ec4-936f-3331c4f03f61/Eve.en: "And yet... it seems we have held these mortals in too high a regard..."<NL><NL>The Leader sneers, his gaze sweeping over the crowd with cold disdain:<NL>"A single wicked bloom was enough to strip away the masks of those common fools. Even after a thousand years, they remain unchanged.<NL>This Martial World Tournament is naught but a nest of ants. It scarce requires the intervention of the Dome followers..."
c0c7e9cc-beff-4ec4-936f-3331c4f03f61/Eve.cn: “不过……吾等终究是高看了凡人……”<NL><NL>神秘人首领言及此处，睥睨众人，神情傲然：<NL>“区区一株妖花，便令那些凡夫俗子丑态毕露……千百年来，竟无一丝长进，<NL>什么武林盟会，不过蝼蚁筑穴，却也不必劳烦吾等天幕众出手……”

c0c7e9cc-beff-4ec4-936f-3331c4f03f61/Opt.en: (A wicked bloom? Could he mean that Red Robed Woman? These strangers call themselves Dome followers, but from where do they hail...)
c0c7e9cc-beff-4ec4-936f-3331c4f03f61/Opt.cn: （妖花，莫非是说那红衣女子？这些神秘人，自称天幕众，又是何来历……）
c0c7e9cc-beff-4ec4-936f-3331c4f03f61/Opt.ru: (Порочный цветок? Мог ли он иметь в виду ту женщину в Красном одеянии? Эти незнакомцы называют себя последователями Купола, но откуда они родом...)

2bd7a06c-f357-43c3-9066-6de8806f30d1/Eve.en: Concealed among the throng, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> grows increasingly uneasy upon hearing the words of the Leader—<NL><NL>This figure brands the Red Robed Woman known as "Yufu Bloom" as a mere wicked bloom, suggesting he knows far more than he lets on.<NL>He speaks as if mortals are but weeds and the common folk mere insects.<NL>Though he professes to uphold the Heavenly Way, he is plainly... of a demonic ilk...
2bd7a06c-f357-43c3-9066-6de8806f30d1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>隐于人群，听闻那天幕众首领所言，心下愈觉蹊跷——<NL><NL>此人将那自号“语茯神花”的红衣女子唤作妖花，似是知晓何种内情，<NL>其言辞之间，视凡人若草芥，观苍生如蝼蚁，<NL>虽自称维护天道，却分明……是妖邪之流……

2bd7a06c-f357-43c3-9066-6de8806f30d1/Opt.en: (Wolves before me and tigers at my back... there truly is no peace in this world...)
2bd7a06c-f357-43c3-9066-6de8806f30d1/Opt.cn: （前有豺狼，后有虎豹……这人间当真好不太平……）
2bd7a06c-f357-43c3-9066-6de8806f30d1/Opt.ru: (Волки передо мной и тигры за моей спиной... В этом мире действительно нет покоя...)

395457ba-4e1d-4b0a-8b33-dfd23a95f972/Eve.en: Just as these thoughts cross <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind,<NL>the Fuyu Hilt within their bosom begins to pulse with a faint heat.<NL>Suddenly, a flash of golden light erupts from the Leader's sleeve, darting toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s brow!<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> lunges aside and stares—it is a long strand of golden thread, glowing with the radiance of a golden sun!<NL><NL>All at once, the Dome followers, once as still as statues, whip around to fix their gaze upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>!
395457ba-4e1d-4b0a-8b33-dfd23a95f972/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思及此处，<NL>怀中「伏虞剑柄」似有所感，微微发烫，<NL>正在这时，一道金光倏然自那神秘人首领袖中飞出，直扑<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>面门！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>侧身避开，定睛看去——竟是一缕丈余金丝，流光溢彩，灿若金轮！<NL><NL>一时之间，原本如木雕泥塑的天幕众，纷纷回身看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>！

1f43d1c7-ac65-4f66-9f42-cc2ddb924057/Eve.en: "A... mortal?"<NL>The Leader narrows his eyes, his gaze locking onto <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a cold, thin smile:<NL>"That you could strike down my followers and track us to this place shows you possess some meager talent.<NL>Alas... a mere insect's journey must end here!"<NL><NL>The words have scarcely left his lips when the Leader flings his sleeves wide, lunging forward to slaughter <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>!
1f43d1c7-ac65-4f66-9f42-cc2ddb924057/Eve.cn: “嗯……凡人？”<NL>天幕众首领神色微凛，眸光落在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身上，微微笑道：<NL>“竟能伤吾天幕之众，寻入此地，倒也算有几分本事，<NL>可惜……蝼蚁之身，也只能止步于此了！”<NL><NL>话音未落，天幕众首领袖袍一振，已向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>袭杀而来！

99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> casts the Leader into a pool of blood,<NL>clamping a vice-like grip around his throat. The gathered Dome followers pale in unison. Not one amongst them dares to advance...
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将天幕众首领击倒在一片血泊中，<NL>五指如钩，反手扼住其咽喉，四周天幕众齐齐变色，无一人敢上前……
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> бросает Лидера в лужу крови,<NL>сжимающий его горло тисками. Собравшиеся последователи Купола бледнеют в унисон. Ни один из них не осмеливается приблизиться...

99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.en: You demonic wretches, skulking in the shadows—tell me, from where did you come?!
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.cn: 尔等妖邪之流，藏形匿迹，究竟是何来历！
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.ru: Вы, демонические негодяи, прячущиеся в тени — скажите мне, откуда вы пришли?!

99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.en: You claim to uphold the Heavenly Tao, yet you lack all compassion. You are no different from the malevolent mystics...
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.cn: 尔等自称护持天道，却毫无悲天悯人之心，实与妖道无异……
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.ru: Ты утверждаешь, что придерживаешься Небесного Дао, но тебе недостает всякого сострадания. Вы ничем не отличаетесь от злобных мистиков...

99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.en: Humans embody the virtues of heaven and earth, the union of Yin and Yang, the finest of the Five Elements. You would do well to remember this...
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.cn: 人者，天地之德，阴阳之交，五行之秀也，阁下需当谨记……
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.ru: Люди воплощают в себе добродетели неба и земли, союз Инь и Ян, прекраснейшего из Пяти элементов. Вам не мешало бы запомнить это...

99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.en: Haha! With such boastful words, I took you for some divine being, yet you are worth even less than a mere insect!
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.cn: 哈哈！口气这般大，我还当是哪路神仙，谁知竟连蝼蚁也不如！
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.ru: Ха-ха! С такими хвастливыми словами я принял тебя за какое-то божественное существо, но ты стоишь даже меньше, чем простое насекомое!

99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.en: Hehe, the Dome followers are but meddling fools. I suspect this Lord Under the Dome is naught but a clownish demon.
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.cn: 呵，天幕之众，土鸡瓦犬……想来那天幕主，也不过老魔小丑。
99246abb-15bb-48d3-bece-40d04f494b6c/Opt.ru: Хе-хе, последователи Купола - всего лишь назойливые дураки. Я подозреваю, что этот Лорд Под Куполом - не что иное, как клоунский демон.

db83dd11-3bb0-4aa5-a6a8-44cb0d69dda5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> lay defeated in a pool of blood...
db83dd11-3bb0-4aa5-a6a8-44cb0d69dda5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被天幕众首领击倒在一片血泊中……
db83dd11-3bb0-4aa5-a6a8-44cb0d69dda5/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> лежал поверженный в луже крови...

93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Eve.en: "Hahaha! Wicked ones?"<NL><NL>The leader of the Dome followers shook with laughter, spattering blood.<NL>Suddenly, his mirth vanished, and he fixed a cold glare upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>:<NL><NL>"Beneath the dome, you mortals are mere insects, steeped in wickedness!<NL>That wicked bloom nearly made me misjudge you. Taiwu... such a scourge will surely ruin the Lord's grand plan!"
93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Eve.cn: “哈哈哈！妖邪之流？”<NL><NL>天幕众首领听闻此言，一时笑得浑身发颤，血沫四溅，<NL>蓦地，那天幕众首领笑意骤敛，冷眼睨向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>：<NL><NL>“天幕之下，尔等凡人，生是蝼蚁，更为妖邪！<NL>偏是那妖花搅扰，竟叫我险些看走了眼——太吾？此等妖邪祸患，定会坏了吾主大计！”

93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.en: You speak with such arrogance... yet when that wicked bloom sowed chaos, why did none of you act?
93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.cn: 说得厉害，那妖花作乱，怎不见尔等出手？
93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.ru: Ты говоришь с таким высокомерием... и все же, когда этот злой цветок посеял хаос, почему никто из вас ничего не предпринял?

93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.en: This Lord Under the Dome... what is their true origin? And what is this grand plan you speak of?
93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.cn: 天幕之主，究竟何等来历？又有何种大计？
93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.ru: Этот Лорд под Куполом... каково их истинное происхождение? И что это за грандиозный план, о котором вы говорите?

93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.en: Even at death's door, you remain utterly unrepentant...
93c5c401-6b43-4301-ae9b-d5f533b086b6/Opt.ru: Даже на пороге смерти вы остаетесь совершенно нераскаянным...

79f07f75-2cc5-4330-a8f2-e16a9002e273/Eve.en: "Hah! Whether one lives or dies is for Heaven to decide, not you!<NL>Successor of Taiwu—the Lord knows of you now. You cannot escape your end for long.<NL>We shall await your arrival... in the Nine Nether Prisons!"
79f07f75-2cc5-4330-a8f2-e16a9002e273/Eve.cn: “呵！天生天杀，岂由尔定？<NL>太吾传人——尔已为吾主所知，早晚难逃一死……<NL>九幽阴狱……吾等恭候大驾！”
79f07f75-2cc5-4330-a8f2-e16a9002e273/Eve.ru: - Ха! Жить человеку или умереть - это решать Небесам, а не вам!<NL>Преемник Тайу — теперь Господь знает о тебе. Ты не сможешь долго избегать своего конца.<NL>Мы будем ждать вашего прибытия... в Девяти Нижних тюрьмах!"

52cef11c-a16f-48d2-90cf-b3fcade24dd2/Eve.en: The leader of the Dome followers waited for no response<NL> from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>. Crossing his hands and raising them high, he murmured with head bowed:<NL>"Heaven's might is brilliant, the Skyveil hangs mystic. My mere insect body is offered before my Lord.<NL>Life is as grass, death as dust and smoke. Between Heaven and Earth, only destiny remains."<NL><NL>Before the prayer ceased, countless golden threads erupted from his form, spreading to his brethren.<NL>They wove into a dense web, swaddling every follower in the cave within heartbeats.<NL>Now, only rows of shimmering golden cocoons remained, glowing with an ethereal light...

1048b640-17b9-4037-9a75-8968c5abfa1c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>在昏暗的洞穴中穿行，<NL>但是由于未穿着神秘人的衣装，很快就引起了注意……
1048b640-17b9-4037-9a75-8968c5abfa1c/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> сделанный <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> путь через полутемную пещеру,<NL>но не хватает одежды Таинственных Существ, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> вскоре привлек их внимание...

0c7621e0-e91d-4760-a347-6291bd9cff54/Eve.en: "An ant has actually managed to slip in. I know not how you found this place, but you are about to lose your life!"
0c7621e0-e91d-4760-a347-6291bd9cff54/Eve.cn: “居然混入了一只蝼蚁，虽不知道你怎么找到这里的，不过你马上就要命丧黄泉了！”
0c7621e0-e91d-4760-a347-6291bd9cff54/Eve.ru: - Муравью действительно удалось проскользнуть внутрь. Я не знаю, как ты нашел это место, но ты вот-вот расстанешься со своей жизнью!"

3c42fbad-cd9d-4065-8033-033b9370dbd1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was struck down into a pool of blood by the Mysterious One...
3c42fbad-cd9d-4065-8033-033b9370dbd1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被神秘人击倒在一片血泊中……
3c42fbad-cd9d-4065-8033-033b9370dbd1/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> был сбит с ног в луже крови Таинственным Существом...

f8a733a1-43d1-4d9c-820e-28df52bfe39d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> struck the Mysterious One down into a pool of blood.<NL>Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> could react, a chant arose from the depths of the cave:<NL>"Celestial majesty resplendent, the heavens hang in darkness, ants of meager flesh, kneel before my presence,<NL>born as common grass, dying as dust and smoke, gazing upon all creation, all is as the Mandate of Heaven decrees."<NL><NL>Before the chant ended, countless golden threads suddenly poured forth, spreading toward the Mysterious Ones all around.<NL>Layer upon layer, they wove into a dense net. In the blink of an eye, the cave full of Mysterious Ones had been entirely enveloped.<NL>All that remained were golden cocoons throughout the cave, glowing with a brilliant luster...
f8a733a1-43d1-4d9c-820e-28df52bfe39d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将神秘人击倒在一片血泊中，<NL>不待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>反应，洞穴深处忽然传出诵声：<NL>“天威昭昭，天幕垂玄，蝼蚁微躯，奉吾尊前，<NL>生如草芥，死作尘烟，俯仰坤乾，惟天命然。”<NL><NL>诵声未落，忽然涌出无数金丝，向四周神秘人蔓延而去，<NL>层层叠叠，织成密网，眨眼之间，竟已将满洞神秘人尽数裹入其中，<NL>唯见满洞金茧，光华灼灼……

f8a733a1-43d1-4d9c-820e-28df52bfe39d/Opt.en: You shall not escape! I still have questions! (Break the golden cocoon!)
f8a733a1-43d1-4d9c-820e-28df52bfe39d/Opt.cn: 不可！尚有疑问未解！（破开金茧！）
f8a733a1-43d1-4d9c-820e-28df52bfe39d/Opt.ru: Тебе не сбежать! У меня все еще есть вопросы! (Разбей золотой кокон!)

70efbe1e-1925-44a5-8cf5-43e2414a314e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> threw a heavy punch, the air howling with the strike.<NL>Yet the moment his fist met the cocoon, the force vanished as if swallowed by the abyss.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart sank, but as they sought another way,<NL>the cave filled with the sound of cracking. Every golden cocoon shattered, dissolving into a flurry of falling ash.<NL>The light died away, leaving the cavern cold and empty...
70efbe1e-1925-44a5-8cf5-43e2414a314e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>运劲挥拳，呼啸而出，<NL>然而拳锋甫及茧身，劲力便如泥牛入海，立时消弭无形，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下一沉，正欲另谋他法，<NL>谁知便在这时，但闻阵阵异响，却见满洞金茧寸寸碎裂，化作漫天飞灰，簌簌而落，<NL>转瞬之间，满洞光华尽敛，四下空无一人……

fa0f4d6d-536e-459e-8ea1-78cabcb38326/Eve.en: Old mysteries remain unsolved while new ones now arise.<NL>Yet the Mysterious Ones have vanished without a trace, and the trail ends here.<NL>Suddenly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart stirred. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> reached out for the sachet, only to find that the golden thread within had also turned to ash...
fa0f4d6d-536e-459e-8ea1-78cabcb38326/Eve.cn: 旧事未明，又添新疑，<NL>然而神秘人已然不知所踪，线索至此而断，<NL>忽而，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头一动，探手取出锦囊，却见其中金丝，也已化作灰烬……

fa0f4d6d-536e-459e-8ea1-78cabcb38326/Opt.en: Such a rare treasure is by no means an object of the mortal world. Just what is the origin of these Mysterious Ones...
fa0f4d6d-536e-459e-8ea1-78cabcb38326/Opt.cn: 此等异宝，绝非凡间之物，这些神秘人究竟何种来历……
fa0f4d6d-536e-459e-8ea1-78cabcb38326/Opt.ru: Такое редкое сокровище ни в коем случае не принадлежит миру смертных. Каково же происхождение этих таинственных существ?..

d7c98d31-77a7-4be4-9faf-58b688d1ec52/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> dwelt on this thought,<NL>the chant from the depths of the cave once more rose in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind.<NL>In a daze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> felt a gaze fall upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>self—<NL><NL>I know not from where it came, as if from all directions at once,<NL>I know not where it went, as if reaching toward all of past and future.<NL>In that single instant, the gaze lowered slightly and came to rest upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>self...
d7c98d31-77a7-4be4-9faf-58b688d1ec52/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思及此处，<NL>那洞穴深处的诵声，不由又浮上心头，<NL>恍惚之间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>竟觉真有一道目光，<NL><NL>不知自何处而来，似自四方上下而来，<NL>不知向何处而去，似向往古来今而去，<NL>只那一瞬，那目光微微垂视，落于己身……
